skills.name: Search Compounds
skills.description: Search for chemical compounds by name, SMILES, or Molfile
skills.instructions: Use the search interface to query compounds. Support structural and text-based search, and respect the visible accessibility affordances in the page header and filters.

skills.name: Browse Taxonomies
skills.description: Explore plant and organism taxonomies from domain to species level
skills.instructions: Navigate through taxonomy hierarchy or use search to find specific taxa

skills.name: Citation Lookup
skills.description: Find references by DOI, or Wikidata identifier
skills.instructions: Enter a DOI, PubMed ID, or Wikidata QID to retrieve publication metadata

skills.name: SPARQL Query
skills.description: Execute structured SPARQL queries against the LOTUS dataset
skills.instructions: Write SPARQL queries to explore the compound-taxon-reference knowledge graph

skills.name: Export Results
skills.description: Download search results as CSV, JSON, or other formats
skills.instructions: After performing a search, use export options to download structured data

skills.name: Curation Workflows
skills.description: Generate QuickStatements to contribute to Wikidata
skills.instructions: Use curation tools to create structured data edits for Wikidata. Keep form labels, visible focus states, and document metadata intact when guiding the workflow.
